name: Battening Down

steps.t: Photograph the cracks forming in the seawall
steps.go: Head to the Wavebreaker and find the cracked concrete by a shipping container near its tip. Use the camera prompt on the cracks.

steps.t: Sample the shoreline near the hotel beach
steps.pin: Sample the shoreline near the hotel beach
steps.go: Go to Azzurro Beach, just north of Hotel Panorama Azzurro. Interact with one pile of washed-up seaweed at the water's edge.

steps.t: Fix the leaking oil pipe in the northeast
steps.go: Follow the big pipeline from the sea to where it meets the seawall, where oil pools on the sand. Interact with the leak to weld it.

notes: Objectives can be done in any order. All Things How says several crack spots may count; the two 'Take a Photo' pins are likely alternative photo spots for step 1. 'Sample Seaweed' and 'Sample the Shoreline' pins are alternatives for step 2. Rewards collected from Apollo, not automatic.

name: Shoring Up Defenses

steps.t: Destroy 5 Wasps
steps.go: Wasps are small white flyers found across the map. Shoot their rotors.

steps.t: Destroy 3 Fireflies
steps.go: Fireflies are the larger grey fire-spitting flyers found all over the map. Destroy three of them.

steps.t: Use 1 ARC Alloy to reinforce the Raider structure on top of any Stacking Yard crane
steps.go: Climb or zipline to the top of any crane in the Stacking Yard. Interact with the posts holding the metal sheet, spending one ARC Alloy.

steps.t: Cover the hotel's shuttered windows with boards
steps.go: Go to the second floor of Hotel Panorama Azzurro. Board up the shutter in room 213.

notes: Any order, can span several raids. Bring or loot one ARC Alloy. 'Repair Raider structure' pin is an alternative crane for step 3. PC Gamer words step 4 as boarding up a single shuttered window; room 213 confirmed, others such as 207 have similar shutters.

name: Safe Harbor

steps.t: Find the clue left by the restaurant kitchen staff
steps.go: Climb to the top-floor restaurant of Hotel Panorama Azzurro and enter the small kitchen. Photograph the sketch on the wall by the cupboards.

steps.t: Find the area portrayed in the sketch
steps.go: Head to the tennis courts just south-west of the hotel. Look by the bench and billboard against the fence.

steps.t: Dig up the buried part
steps.go: Interact with the shovel stuck in the ground behind the bench. It hands you the Precision Gimbal.

steps.t: Deliver the Precision Gimbal to Tian Wen
steps.go: Delivery in Speranza. Extract with the gimbal, ideally in a safe pocket, and hand it to Tian Wen.

notes: Must be done in one round. Guides disagree slightly on which side of the tennis courts the shovel is (PC Gamer north-west fence, GameTyrant east side by middle court); follow the pin.

name: Celeste's Teenage Rebellion

steps.t: Reach the lookout tower on Mulatierra Hill
steps.pin: Reach the lookout tower on Mulatierra Hill
steps.go: Go to the lookout tower north of Customs House, beside a Raider Hatch. Enter through the opening at its base.

steps.t: Transmit the location from the top of the tower
steps.pin: Transmit from the top of the tower
steps.go: Climb both ladders to the observation deck. Hold the transmit prompt at the upper window.

steps.t: Reach the old Raider Camp
steps.go: Head to the cliff-top camp between Hotel Panorama Azzurro and Azzurro Beach, near the Wharf.

steps.t: Search for a radio transmitter at the Raider Camp
steps.go: At the camp, find the antenna pole and radio. Hold the inspect prompt.

steps.t: Find the large antenna overlooking the harbour
steps.go: Travel to the small hill at the far north-east edge, past the Wavebreaker. The big antenna stands there with a trailer generator.

steps.t: Weld the broken generator
steps.go: Interact with the trailer generator at the antenna base to weld it.

steps.t: Start the transmitter
steps.go: Interact with the repaired generator again to switch the power on.

notes: All three guides agree on the three locations and order. Sub-step wording varies: Destructoid says 'search for a radio transmitter' where others say inspect the antenna; for the last step guides say weld then enable power, so 'Start the transmitter' text follows the MetaForge pin. Optional: spot three ARC from the tower (GameTyrant). Giver named only by All Things How.

name: Celeste's Childhood Drawings

steps.t: Find young Celeste's room in Hotel Panorama Azzurro
steps.go: Take the hotel stairs to the second floor and go to the south-east wing. Enter room 213.

steps.t: Search for anything significant in Celeste's Room
steps.go: Inspect the map lying on the low cabinet between the two windows.

steps.t: Find the drawing on the roof of the third Customs House
steps.pin: Drawing on the third Customs House
steps.go: At Customs House, count three buildings from the south and climb the outside stairs to the roof. Inspect the small painting on the rusty panel by the containers.

steps.t: Find the drawing at the Quay
steps.pin: Find the drawing at the Quay
steps.go: Go to the Quay on the far east, past the Stacking Yard. Inspect the cable reel by the red cranes, second from the south end.

notes: Steps agree across three guides. Destructoid merges the room search into finding the room. Quest giver Lance is named only by All Things How (reward includes Lance's Mixtape charm); verify. No item to extract, so a free loadout works.
